In this video we cover:
PG Electroplast: Growth, Struggles & Diversification
PG Electroplast, a leading Indian contract manufacturer, is facing challenges from weak AC sales, margin pressure, and rising inventories. To reduce dependence on the seasonal AC segment, the company has partnered with global POS maker PAX Technologies and is expanding into washing machines, refrigerators, and electronics. This video looks at PG Electroplast’s financial performance, struggles, and future growth plans.
